title: Paylocity pricing - $20-$40 per employee/month across three tiers
clean_text: Paylocity does not publish list pricing; as of May 2026, third-party buyer reports cite three tiers: Core at $20/employee/month (core payroll, tax calculations, payment issuance), Professional at $30/employee/month (adds direct deposit, time tracking, basic benefits administration), and Enterprise at $40/employee/month (advanced benefits, learning management, talent management, compliance tools). Other industry estimates put the range at $22-$32 PEPM, or $26-$33 PEPM for the full HCM suite. Based on 13 verified purchases, the median annual contract is $42,240, with at least 6 documented hidden costs (implementation, training, add-ons) beyond the listed per-employee rate.
